system.description:
You weave summoning seals together and infuse them with medical release chakra manifesting the mask of the Reaper of death.

Attacks you make deal an additional +2 necrotic damage for the duration. If you would deal damage to a creature who has ranks of an Elemental or Physical condition, then this jutsu’s additional damage instead becomes a +4. If an attack you make scores a critical hit, you may double this jutsu’s damage bonus.
